articles.headline: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
articles.summary: Google is rolling out agentic AI capabilities in Gemini with an initial focus on business users, which could accelerate workflow automation and change how companies deploy AI across teams. For executives, the key implication is faster adoption of AI assistants that can potentially reduce labor time in routine knowledge work and increase pressure to prove ROI on software spend.

articles.headline: TSMC reports strong September revenue as AI demand keeps chip sales elevated
articles.summary: TSMC said September revenue rose sharply year over year, reinforcing that AI infrastructure demand is still supporting chip manufacturing volumes. For businesses, this points to continued tightness and strategic importance in the semiconductor supply chain, especially for companies exposed to data center buildouts, AI hardware demand, and advanced-node capacity.

articles.headline: Atlassian launches Forward Deployed Engineering for enterprise AI deployment
articles.summary: Atlassian’s new program embeds senior AI engineers into customer environments to turn AI pilots into production workflows, a sign that vendors are moving from experimentation to implementation support. This matters for businesses because it can shorten deployment timelines for automation, but it also signals higher expectations for governance, customization, and measurable productivity gains.
